T0545.title: SaaS
T0545.definition: Software as a service delivered through a provider-operated application and managed through tenant-level configuration.
T0545.description: SaaS security depends on tenant configuration, third-party integrations, and user authorization. Common risks include broad sharing, external app grants, administrator misuse, and insufficient audit logs. Reviews should cover identity integration, data export, collaboration links, tenant isolation, and supplier access.
T0545.usageExample: Assess SaaS related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
